newsitem.title: UK: Pru no comment on NatWest report.
newsitem.headline: Pru no comment on NatWest report.

text.p: Britain's largest life insurer Prudential Corp Plc on Monday declined to comment on reports that it had held talks with retail bank National Westminster Bank Plc about a possible merger.
It has been widely reported that preliminary talks between the two began two weeks ago.
Industry observers said the talks broke down because of disagreement about who would land the top jobs.

A proposal that NatWest's chairman Lord Alexander should be chairman of the combined group with the Pru's Sir Peter Davies becoming chief executive found little favour with the NatWest board, said one.
In the past, Pru has made no secret of its desire to establish a high street distribution network which a building society link up would provide.
NatWest, with around 1,900 UK branches, would offer similar opportunities for the Pru to widen its customer base and increase its distribution outlets and product range.
